(ns native.vertical.reader-provider)
(defn make-helper [fallback] (fn [c] (if (erlang/is_integer c) (or (erlang/== c 32) (erlang/== c 9) (erlang/== c 10) (erlang/== c 13) (erlang/== c 44)) (fallback c))))
(defn make-tagged [fallback] (let [helper (make-helper fallback)] (fn [c] [1 (helper c)])))

(ns native.vertical.reader-consumer (:require [native.vertical.reader-provider :as p]))
